fusions.name: Stotting Strike
fusions.desc: A bounding kick at a target up to 5 tiles away that deals 7 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full range. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Startled Buck
fusions.desc: You buck at the target for 11 damage, knocking it 3 tiles back and leaving it 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Flinch Aside
fusions.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 20% for 10 seconds and leaps you 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Shying Step
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a blow you failed to dodge rolls your dodge a second time, and the second roll stands.
